# foundry_schedule (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `enable_preview = ["schedules"]` on the provider. Preview features may change or be removed in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up an existing schedule by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# foundry_schedule is a preview feature. It requires an explicit opt-in on
# the provider before it can be used, and preview features may change or be
# removed in any provider release without following semantic versioning.
provider "foundry" {
  account_name   = var.foundry_account_name
  project_name   = var.foundry_project_name
  enable_preview = ["schedules"]
}

data "foundry_schedule" "nightly_evaluation" {
  id = "nightly-evaluation"
}

output "schedule_provisioning_status" {
  value = data.foundry_schedule.nightly_evaluation.provisioning_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the schedule to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the schedule.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the schedule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is enabled.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties attached to the schedule.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status of the schedule: `Creating`, `Updating`, `Deleting`, `Succeeded`, or `Failed`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key-value tags attached to the schedule.
- `task` (Attributes) The schedule's task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--task))
- `trigger` (Attributes) The schedule's trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger))

<a id="nestedatt--task"></a>
### Nested Schema for `task`

Read-Only:

- `evaluation_id` (String) Identifier of the evaluation group, set when `type` is `Evaluation`.
- `evaluation_run` (String) JSON-encoded evaluation run payload, set when `type` is `Evaluation`.
- `insight` (String) JSON-encoded insight payload, set when `type` is `Insight`.
- `type` (String) Task type, `Evaluation` or `Insight`.


<a id="nestedatt--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger`

Read-Only:

- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression defining the schedule frequency, set when `type` is `Cron`.
- `days_of_month` (List of Number) Days of the month for a `Monthly` recurrence schedule.
- `days_of_week` (List of String) Days of the week for a `Weekly` recurrence schedule.
- `end_time` (String) ISO 8601 end time for `Cron` or `Recurrence` triggers.
- `hours` (List of Number) Hours of the day for a `Daily` recurrence schedule.
- `interval` (Number) Interval for a `Recurrence` trigger.
- `recurrence_type` (String) Recurrence pattern for a `Recurrence` trigger.
- `start_time` (String) ISO 8601 start time for `Cron` or `Recurrence` triggers.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone for the trigger.
- `trigger_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which a `OneTime` trigger fires.
- `type` (String) Trigger type: `Cron`, `Recurrence`, or `OneTime`.
